why_not_one_block_off: No corridor is shared, so no position could honestly be recorded. The two sheets overlap only in the street (y) direction; in x they sit four or more avenues apart. Sheet 70 draws avenues K, L, M and M 1/2 over streets 33RD-36TH: crop cand2 letters 'AVENUE K' at its west margin (neighbour plate '69' beyond) with the 1100 block of 35TH/36TH ST (1102-1124 / 1101-1123) east of it, and crop cand1 letters 'AVENUE L' and 'AVENUE M' flanking the 1200 block (1202-1224 / 1201-1223); avenue-face numbers run 3401-3428 and 3501-3528. Its south margin references read '77' and '78', not 76. Sheet 76 draws avenues G, H and I (with F at its west edge) over streets 36TH-39TH: crop cand1 letters 'AVE. G OR WINNIE' and 'AVE. H OR BALL' flanking the 700 block of 36TH/37TH ST (701-724) with the 800 block (801-808) east of Ave H, and crop cand2 letters 'AVE. H OR BALL' and 'AVE. I OR SEALY' flanking the 800 block (801-824), Ave I being its east margin with neighbour plate '77' beyond; avenue-face numbers run 3601-3628 and 3701-3722. Its north margin reference reads '68', not 70. So sheet 70's hundred-blocks run 1100-1300 and sheet 76's run 600-800: the avenues I 1/2, J (Broadway) and K's west side (hundred-blocks 900-1000) lie between them. Sheet 76's easternmost avenue (Ave I) is still well west of sheet 70's westernmost (Ave K), so no avenue crosses both plates and no identification is possible. The detector's near-seam candidates (sheet 70 x=1572, sheet 76 x=1761) are both mid-block - sheet 70 x=1572 lies inside the 1200 block between the 1210 and 1212 frontages, sheet 76 x=1761 inside the 700 block between the 713/715 frontages - and in any case belong to different avenue columns. Reported UNRESOLVED rather than forcing a control between plates that share no corridor.
